content.subject: Quick question
content.draft_text:
Hi Riley,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. We help operations teams automate manual, reconciliation-heavy processes.

Saw that TrueNorth raised $50 million from Sam Altman and others to empower independent truckers. I imagine keeping reconciliation records aligned across expanding partner systems can become increasingly time-consuming.

We extract transaction data from disparate sources, match entries, and generate balanced ledgers, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something you're thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
